messages.author: ef8463d2fe864477
messages.subject: HTTP authentication
parts:
Hello rApache users,

Is it possible to issue an HTTP authentication request to the user using rApache/Rook and remember the login?

I want to have a similar behaviour as doing in php:
<?php
if (!isset($_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_USER'])) {
    header('WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="My Realm"');
    header('HTTP/1.0 401 Unauthorized');
    echo 'Text to send if user hits Cancel button';
    exit;
} else {
    echo "<p>Hello {$_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_USER']}.</p>";
    echo "<p>You entered {$_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_PW']} as your password.</p>";
}
?>

The first time a login-form is displayed and the next times, $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_USER'] and $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_PW'] are set accordingly.
When user and password have been provided, I next want to validate MD5 hash of the password by quering an existing database.



Using Rook I have tried the following:

    app <- function(env){
        req <- Request$new(env)
        res <- Response$new()
       
        #res$header('WWW-Authenticate','Basic realm="My Realm"'); res$status <- 401L
        res$header('WWW-Authenticate','Basic'); res$status <- 401L
        res$write('<h1>Authorization required</h1>\n')
        res$write( res$status )
        res$finish()
    }
   
 
However, I am not being asked for the password and the h1 line is displayed immediately.
I tried i both on the R server and on the Apache where  the code above is called as described in
http://jeffreyhorner.tumblr.com/post/27861973339/deploy-rook-apps-with-rapache-part-i

How can I retrieve the values from the Request object, as they are provided in php with $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_USER'] and $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_PW']?

If HTTP authentication is not supported, what is the recommended way to implement access restrictions using rApache/Rook?

Yours,
Thomas
